literal_meaning: স্পর্শকরণ বা ছড়িয়ে দেওয়া (scattering or sprinkling)
figurative_meaning_en: reckless squandering or wastage due to negligence
example_sentences_in_bangla: ঘরের জিনিসপত্রের ছড়াছড়ি করে সব নষ্ট হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: There's a reckless squandering of money in the government project.
The careless scattering of household items led to everything being wasted.
note: Refers to careless distribution, often in contexts of public funds
